killedBy: hud: the match-failure overlay is reachable by keyboard and D-pad (issue #327) a controller's D-pad and Confirm both act inside the overlay
why: Drops the match-failure overlay out of the population `activePanelContainer` derives, restoring the state issue #912 fixed: the overlay was operable by pointer and Tab only, so a pad player who hit a failed match could dismiss it with B and never choose Retry -- which is the whole point of the screen. Measured before the fix: with the overlay up, `act('down')` and `act('confirm')` both returned false while the sibling confirmation walked its two buttons normally.
